coverage: All required input obligations are checked before one producer invocation/materialization. Input FAIL and ERROR-under-WARN invoke no function; independent aliases still return their results.

Closed output candidate checks bind the same artifact digest used by publication. FAIL and ERROR preserve the old version/head; WARN remains VIOLATION with exact metrics linked to the new consumer version.
One parent reservation supports sequential helper/producer permits at max_jobs=1, and one shared Budget supplies independent transform/input/output deadlines.

Repeated aliases and identical declarations on input/output have distinct scoped contract obligations. A pre-existing provider PASS quality record remains unchanged through consumer failures and success.
Missing obligations and changed versions fail before producer execution. Nonexecuted output checks report SKIPPED with a reason.

Failed output candidates and precommit cancellation/conflicts retain readable sealed objects with no dataset version/head reference. Changed candidate bytes are rejected, not retained as trusted evidence.

SQLite persistence atomically rejects ERROR, SKIPPED, missing, duplicate, wrong-attempt/artifact/version/alias/definition/phase, inexact, late, wrong-severity and canceled evidence. Published warning evidence cannot be overwritten.

Explicit cancellation before execution, after materialization and before publication, persisted cancellation, generation conflicts, candidate tampering, helper failure and producer exceptions all preserve last-good visibility.
